hyperedges.label: Docker Compose Service Stack
hyperedges.description: Complete Docker Compose service stack defining the POS application infrastructure with app, nginx, database, Redis, queue worker, and scheduler services all connected via a bridge network.

hyperedges.label: POS UI/UX Design Pattern
hyperedges.description: The POS UI/UX design pattern emphasizing fast cashier workflow: prominent total, visible cart, search/filter products, minimize clicks, loading states, toast feedback, and clear validation throughout the transaction process.

hyperedges.label: POS Sale Lifecycle (Checkout to Receipt)
hyperedges.description: The complete POS sale lifecycle: products are searched and added to cart, a sale record and sale items are created within a database transaction, stock is decremented, and a receipt is generated for the transaction history.

nodes.label: UX Feedback Patterns
nodes.rationale: Use confirmation dialogs for dangerous actions, toast notifications for feedback, clear form validation, and user-friendly error messages.

nodes.label: Loading States and Skeleton Loading
nodes.rationale: Use loading state and skeleton loading for perceived performance. Empty states must be informative.

nodes.label: Docker Architecture Requirements
nodes.rationale: Application must run via Docker Compose. Minimum containers: Laravel/PHP, Web server, MySQL. Architecture must be extensible for Redis, Queue Worker, Scheduler, Mail Service.

nodes.label: UI/UX Guidelines
nodes.rationale: Prioritize cashier ease of use, consistency, visual hierarchy, responsive design across all pages. Avoid generic CRUD admin template appearance.

nodes.label: Struk (Receipt) Module
nodes.rationale: Receipt design must support thermal printer usage in the future.

nodes.label: Thermal Printer Support Concept
nodes.rationale: Receipt layout must be designed to support thermal printer hardware in the future, influencing the receipt module design from the start.

nodes.label: Database Transaction Pattern
nodes.rationale: All POS transaction processing must use database transactions. If any step fails, the entire transaction must be rolled back. Stock must never go negative.

nodes.label: Future Extensibility Design
nodes.rationale: Docker architecture must be easily extensible for Redis, Queue Worker, Scheduler, and Mail Service. Database must be designed for additional modules. Reporting must be extensible for additional report types.

nodes.label: POS Design Principles
nodes.rationale: POS page must be optimized for fast cashier use. Minimize clicks to complete a transaction. Cart always visible. Total payment must be prominent. 'Bayar' (Pay) is primary action.
